serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: VulcanGov (Justinian for Government) is a SaaS AI platform for government: an AI agent workspace grounded in a curated, continuously updated library of federal and state statutes, regulations, guidance and housing datasets, with full-text and semantic search, secure single-use agent sandboxes for code execution and document generation, and an administration console for agency user management, session audit visibility and usage export. It is delivered from a government-only environment in AWS GovCloud (US) (us-gov-east-1) on a containerized microservices architecture: AWS ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, S3 object storage, OpenSearch and ElastiCache. Federal customer data is stored and processed in AWS GovCloud (US); large language model inference is provided by Amazon Bedrock through a documented transport bridge, and every cross-boundary resource, including any temporary deviation, is disclosed in the published third-party information resources and service-scope lists rather than omitted. Data is encrypted at rest (AWS KMS, AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2/1.3) with FIPS 140-validated cryptographic modules; identity and access are federated through Okta for Government with enforced multi-factor authentication; security monitoring uses Datadog for Government, Wiz for Government and native AWS security services. Available to federal, state and local governments and to organizations working on their behalf. Public offering information, the secure configuration guide and live availability status are published on the Trust Center at https://trust.vulcangov.app; FedRAMP Certification Data is available to federal reviewers through its gated portal.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: VulcanGov FedRAMP Trust Center: public offering information (human-readable and JSON), in-scope service list, certification progress, and live availability status (status.vulcangov.app). Federal agency access to full FedRAMP Certification Data is provided through the gated portal.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The public tier requires no authentication. Federal agency users obtain FedRAMP Certification Data through the gated portal at https://trust.vulcangov.app/portal: enter a .gov or .mil email address, receive a one-time code by email, and download artifacts for 12 hours; no approval step and no provider action is required. Programmatic access (artifact index and downloads with the session token) is documented at https://trust.vulcangov.app/portal/api-docs. Parties without a .gov/.mil address (for example contractors acting on behalf of an agency) may request access by emailing security@vulcan.ai from their organizational address.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Conversational AI and long-running agent sessions, including file uploads for AI-assisted analysis and Office-compatible document collaboration. File uploads are in the assessed scope; deployment restrictions and required administrative grants are described in the Secure Configuration Guide.
Curated legal, regulatory, legislative, and housing datasets with full-text and semantic search, kept current by automated synchronization.
Isolated, single-use execution environments that support agent sessions (code execution, document generation).
Organization and user management, session audit visibility, and usage export for agency administrators.

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US), FedRAMP High. Infrastructure hosting: VulcanGov infrastructure and federal customer data reside in AWS GovCloud (US), apart from the disclosed cross-boundary resources listed here.

AWS US East/West, FedRAMP Moderate. Amazon Bedrock model inference for the platform's AI features: Anthropic Claude models through US cross-region inference profiles that route only to us-east-1, us-east-2 and us-west-2, reached only through the platform's documented transport bridge. Bedrock receives user prompts and the content supplied with them and returns model output; model invocation logging is not enabled in the bridge account, so prompts and outputs are not retained there.
AWS US East/West, FedRAMP Moderate. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore managed web search (AgentCore Web Search Tool), reached only through the platform's documented transport bridge.
Datadog for Government, FedRAMP High. Monitoring, logging and application telemetry.
Okta for Government High (Okta IDaaS Government High Cloud), FedRAMP High. Identity and single sign-on for VulcanGov users.
Wiz for U.S. Government, FedRAMP High. Cloud security posture management and agentless vulnerability scanning of the VulcanGov AWS GovCloud (US) environment.

independentAssessmentSummary.summary: A-LIGN (FedRAMP Recognized independent assessor; lead assessor Dennis Coats) completed the initial FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) independent assessment of VulcanGov on September 11, 2026. All 203 applicable FedRAMP Consolidated Rules were assessed: 202 were found implemented and 1 gap was identified — FRC-APP-AFC, the FedRAMP Certification Application Form, which had not yet been filed at the assessment date. Provider follow-up: the application was filed September 14, 2026 (ticket 67477), and the provider recorded closure in SDR v48. This follow-up does not change the assessor's September 11 findings. All 46 Key Security Indicators were determined to be implemented and to meet the Class C bar of at least two automated validation methods per KSI. The six-month KSI validation history continues to accrue under the initial-certification arrangement. The assessor's report and control-testing export are available to agencies through the Trust Center portal.
independentAssessmentSummary.note: Overall summary of the FedRAMP independent assessment (IVV-IAS-OSA) as reflected in the assessor's report cover summary; the assessor's full report and per-rule testing export are published as gated-tier artifacts (independent-assessment class) following the CISO's first-publication review (CDS-CSO-RIS) on 2026-09-11.
